short_summary: A Paytm payment receipt showing a successful transaction of Rs 50,000 to Sk Nasir Hossain.
detailed_description: The image displays a mobile application screenshot of a Paytm payment receipt.
At the top center, the blue Paytm logo is prominently displayed along with the text 'PAYMENT RECEIPT'.
Below the header, a light blue card indicates a successful transaction.
The card prominently features the text 'Payment Successful' at the top.
The transaction amount '₹50,000' is displayed in large bold font.
A green verified checkmark icon is located to the right of the amount.
Below the amount, the text 'Rupees Fifty Thousand Only' is written in a smaller font.
A white paper-like receipt section sits below the blue card with a jagged bottom edge.
The receipt contains 'To: Sk Nasir Hossain' as the recipient name.
Under the recipient name, the bank details 'State Bank Of India - 1037' are shown.
A dashed horizontal line separates the recipient and sender details.
The sender is listed as 'From: S E Interior'.
Under the sender name, the bank details 'ICICI Bank - 1319' are displayed.
An 'i' icon is placed near the sender details section.
A circular placeholder button is present near the recipient details.
The 'UPI Ref ID: 318129955340' is clearly printed towards the bottom of the receipt.
The transaction timestamp '30 Jun, 01:14 PM' is displayed below the UPI Ref ID.
At the bottom of the main white container, a security badge icon is shown alongside the text '100% SECURE PAYMENTS'.
At the very bottom of the screen, the 'POWERED BY UPI' logo is centered.
The overall background of the screen is a very light off-white/gray color.
The UI uses clean sans-serif typography throughout.
The color palette consists of white, light blue, dark blue, green, and neutral grays.
The layout is structured vertically, resembling a digital physical receipt.
Shadows are subtly used to give depth to the cards and elements.
The alignment of all elements is centered within the main container view.
The top blue card features rounded corners.
The receipt edges mimic a traditional perforated paper receipt at the bottom.
The branding colors reflect Paytm's official corporate identity (blue and white).
Text contrast is high, ensuring good legibility against backgrounds.
There are no visible scrollbars or navigation bars present in this specific view.
